tests.name: PASS panel-uniform: registered identity, contact controls, six settings groups and shared model cards

manual.reason: The pending-change-only visibility of the contact save/cancel actions is asserted by the static source marker gate, which the change itself documents as insufficient for actual rendered position and occlusion; there is no named rendered test.
manual.steps: Open the contact panel with no pending change, then edit one field, and read whether the save and cancel actions are present.
manual.expected: Both actions are absent while no field is edited and appear as soon as a field changes, while per-field persistence and failure recovery keep working.
